summary: Learn SPSS data preparation, descriptive analysis and basic tests through guided practice. Explore the five-day course and syllabus.
lede: SPSS training helps research assistants, monitoring analysts and business researchers prepare datasets and produce statistical summaries. It covers defining variables, checking data quality, creating descriptive tables and charts, and using crosstabs and introductory statistical tests. Learners also practise interpreting results and documenting analysis with SPSS Syntax so findings can be reviewed and rerun.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who prepare, analyse or report data in IBM SPSS Statistics and need a structured foundation for routine statistical work.
modules: IBM SPSS Workspace and File Flow
prerequisites: Basic computer skills and familiarity with rows, columns and common spreadsheet data are useful. No programming experience is required; exercises use the IBM SPSS Statistics interface, with introductory exposure to SPSS Syntax.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
